tytul: Dry-aged raw venison loin: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for raw red deer or roe deer loin that is aged or cured dry and eaten without cooking. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the EU, freezing under the recommended conditions kills parasites, but some Trichinella species found in game animals and horses are resistant to it. [T:MIE-033]
In the EU, meat from horses, wild game and other animals that could carry Trichinella must be examined for this parasite. [T:MIE-034]
NCHFP says it is best not to make jerky from game meat soiled by gut contents, and to use such meat only in ways that it will be thoroughly cooked. [T:MIE-043]
